title: From Correctness to Consistency: Redefining Reliability for the Agentware Era
abstract: arXiv:2611.27829v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rise of "vibe coding" has marginalized requirements analysis, allowing unverified "Make it Work" assumptions to accumulate into complex defects that evade standard testing. In the absence of a reliable ground truth oracle, we advocate a paradigm shift from correctness verification to logic consistency. We introduce Differential Logic Analysis (DLA), a framework that utilizes Logical Inference to detect internal contradictions across parallel and sequential development workflows. Preliminary simulations demonstrate that DLA successfully intercepts logic drift, such as contradictions and unspecified assumptions, and offers a new perspective on reliability assessment in the AI-assistant development era.

translated_title: 从正确性到一致性：重新定义智能体软件（Agentware）时代的可靠性
translated_abstract: “氛围编程”（vibe coding）的兴起使需求分析被边缘化，导致未经证实的“能用就行”（Make it Work）假设不断累积，形成逃避标准测试的复杂缺陷。在缺乏可靠真实基准（ground truth oracle）的情况下，我们倡导从正确性验证向逻辑一致性的范式转变。我们提出了差分逻辑分析（Differential Logic Analysis, DLA），这是一个利用逻辑推理来检测并行与串行开发工作流中内部矛盾的框架。初步仿真表明，DLA能够成功拦截逻辑漂移（如矛盾和未明确说明的假设），为AI辅助开发时代的可靠性评估提供了新的视角。
tldr: 该论文提出差分逻辑分析（DLA）框架，利用逻辑推理检测开发流程中的内部矛盾与逻辑漂移，将软件可靠性评估从传统的正确性验证转向逻辑一致性，以应对“氛围编程”和AI辅助开发时代的挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Differential Logic Analysis (DLA), a framework that uses logical inference to detect internal contradictions and logic drift across development workflows, shifting software reliability assessment from correctness verification to logical consistency for the AI-assisted development era.
